title: Pika published its Pika Audio model family and Pika Music playground
summary: On 2026-08-17, Pika published official pages for its Pika Audio models, developer API documentation, and a Pika Music playground. These links show that Pika extended its public product surface with audio-model and music-generation access. The supplied links alone do not establish model specifications, pricing, or availability terms.
research_notes: The linked first-party overview is dated 2026-08-14 and adds Soundtrack, Music, SFX, and Speech to the Pika API Club.
